messages:
emma_sales: Hey team — FinSafe pre-sales ask: they want a short POC with strict EU-only data residency, BYO-KMS, and tenant pinning so traffic never leaves EU. Also asked: can we guarantee no US sub-processors touch customer data? Need scope + rough cost uplift and timeline.

oscar_se: quick clarifying Qs — is this for Hosted API with residency controls or for Dedicated/Private? Also, do they need control-plane signaling to be EU-only or both control+data? Pricing will differ a lot.

emma_sales: Hosted is preferred by the buyer but they're open to Dedicated. Control-plane ideally EU-only but they said data path is the blocker. They asked about subprocessor list before legal signs SOW.

liam_eng_ops: TL;DR: we can do EU-only data residency but tradeoffs:
- Hosted API: tenant pinning to EU region (eg eu-central-1) + subprocessor whitelisting possible, but control plane may still use global services unless we provision a Private control-plane.
- Dedicated/Private: full EU control plane + no cross-border backups if configured — recommended for strict no-US requirement.

Notes/ops:
```
routing:
  tenant_pin:
    primary_region: eu-central-1
    fallback_policy: "eu-only"  # fallback stays within EU
    subprocessors_allowed:
      - aws-eu-central-1
      - azure-northeurope
      - monitoring-datadog-eu
```

Caveats: some third-party telemetry (error reporting, metrics ingestion) can be configured to EU endpoints but requires opt-in. Also BYO-KMS flow: we support external customer KMS via KMS-proxy or HSM integration, but key import + attestation adds ~1–2 weeks of work.

liam_eng_ops: cost ballpark: Hosted w/ EU pinning + subproc whitelist: ~+20% to token margin due to reserved capacity and routing overhead. Dedicated: one-time provisioning + monthly reserved OPEX (depends on GPU units) — estimate provided after we size QPS.

jana_product: We can offer a 60–90 day POC: staging dedicated pool in eu-central-1, BYO-KMS stub, and an ops runbook. Legal will need the subprocessors appendix signed. I can own the POC SOW template. :white_check_mark: 

security_bot: Security checklist items required for POC: DPA with subprocessors list, KMS attestation docs, network diagram showing egress path, SOC2 + penetration test summary. If they require no US subprocessors, we must confirm each vendor's EU-only processing mode.

emma_sales: OK — next steps: 1) I'll confirm with FinSafe whether Hosted with EU-only control-plane is acceptable or if they insist on Private. 2) @liam_eng_ops can you draft the ops handoff + precise subprocessors list and estimated cost uplift by EOD? 3) @jana_product please prep the POC SOW template and flag legal prerequisites.

liam_eng_ops: Will do. I'll include a short runbook, the subprocessors CSV (regions + endpoints), and two pricing scenarios (Hosted EU-pin vs Dedicated). Expect first draft in ~6 hours.

emma_sales: Great — thanks everyone. I'll update FinSafe and push their decision back here. :thumbsup:
